title: Verb Types and Conjugation (~ます / ~ません)
explanation: Japanese verbs are grouped into Ru-verbs, U-verbs, and Irregular verbs. To make them polite, we change them into the ~ます (affirmative) and ~ません (negative) forms.
structure:
Ru-verbs: Drop る + ます/ません
U-verbs: Change 'u' sound to 'i' sound + ます/ません
Irregular: する -> します / くる -> きます

examples.japanese: 私は毎日コーヒーを飲みます。
今日は朝ごはんを食べません。
examples.english: I will not eat breakfast today.

practice.question: 音楽を（　）。(I listen to music - きく)
Translate: 'I do not sleep.' (verb: ねる)

title: Particles (を、で、に、へ)
explanation:
Particles show the grammatical function of words.
- を: Marks the direct object of an action.
- で: Marks the location of an action.
- に: Marks time (when), or destination of motion.
- へ: Marks destination (similar to に for motion).

examples.japanese: 図書館で本を読みます。
examples.english: I will read books in the library.

examples.japanese: 週末に京都へ行きます。
examples.english: I will go to Kyoto on the weekend.

practice.question: Translate: 'I will watch TV at home.'

title: Time References (When to use に)
explanation: You use 'に' with precise times (days of the week, times, dates). You do NOT use 'に' for relative times (today, tomorrow, every day, next week).

examples.japanese: 日曜日に映画を見ます。
examples.english: I will watch a movie on Sunday.

practice.question: 今日（　）学校に行きます。(No particle / に)

title: ~ませんか (Invitation)
explanation: To politely invite someone to do something, use the negative question form of the verb: '~ませんか'.

examples.japanese: 一緒に昼ごはんを食べませんか。
examples.english: Won't you eat lunch with me?
Would you like to play tennis?

practice.question: Translate: 'Would you like to drink coffee?'
practice.answer: コーヒーを飲みませんか。

title: Frequency Adverbs
explanation: Adverbs like 毎日(every day), よく(often), 時々(sometimes), あまり(not much), ぜんぜん(not at all). 'あまり' and 'ぜんぜん' must be used with a negative verb.

examples.japanese: 私はよくスポーツをします。
私はぜんぜんテレビを見ません。
examples.english: I don't watch TV at all.

practice.question: Use 'あまり' to say you don't read books much.
practice.answer: 私はあまり本を読みません。
